claims.claim: The Ai Pin is priced at $700.
There is a $24 monthly subscription required to use the device on the Humane network, which is powered by T-Mobile.
Orders for the Ai Pin are set to begin in the United States on November 16.
The Ai Pin has a laser projector that can project information onto the user's hand.
The Ai Pin has a 13-megapixel ultra wide-angle camera that can capture photos and videos using a two-finger double tap or voice command.
The Ai Pin can provide nutritional information and determine if a food item is 'safe' to eat based on user health goals.

No apps; all functions accessed via AI assistant
